commitResults.messageBody: Introduce TaskList as the owner of in-memory task storage and basic add, retrieve, remove, size, and persistence-copy operations. DobbyLogic now delegates collection management while retaining command behavior, which reduces its responsibilities without altering console output. Update the UI test-plan compilation commands to include the new class.

Move standard-input handling and the welcome, prompt, divider, and farewell output from Dobby into Ui. Dobby now coordinates the application loop while Ui owns console interaction, establishing the boundary needed for future command objects to report results without coupling themselves to System.in or System.out. Update UI test-plan compilation commands to include Ui.

Add the Command abstraction, ListCommand, and Parser. Valid list input now becomes a ListCommand that delegates task display to DobbyLogic, establishing a small command-object execution path while retaining existing handling for the remaining commands. Rename DobbyLogic's internal enum to CommandType to distinguish it from the new abstraction, and update UI test-plan compilation commands.

Add ExitCommand and extend Parser to recognize bye. Dobby now parses each input once, exits based on Command.isExit(), and executes recognized commands in the application loop; commands not yet extracted still delegate to DobbyLogic. Remove the former special isBye check and update UI test-plan compile commands.

Add MarkCommand and UnmarkCommand, each carrying a one-based task number parsed from valid mark or unmark input. Move shared completion-status behavior into DobbyLogic.changeTaskStatus while retaining existing fallback validation and error messages for malformed commands. Update the UI test-plan compilation commands.

Add DeleteCommand to represent valid delete commands with a one-based task number. Parser now constructs it for valid input, while DobbyLogic.deleteTask centralizes deletion validation, persistence, and the established confirmation message. Malformed delete input still uses the existing fallback validation path. Update UI test-plan compilation commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract todo deadline and event commands
commitResults.messageBody: Add TodoCommand, DeadlineCommand, and EventCommand to represent valid task-creation requests and their parsed data. Extend Parser to recognize valid task descriptions, markers, and dates, while malformed inputs continue to use DobbyLogic's established validation messages. The logic class retains task creation and persistence operations. Update UI test-plan compilation commands.

Make Parser return a command for every non-EOF input, including InvalidCommand for blank, unknown, malformed, and invalid-date commands. Dobby now always executes the parsed command, removing the runtime fallback from the application loop. InvalidCommand preserves the established console messages through DobbyLogic.showMessage, while existing task commands retain their domain operations.

Delete the unused command-token parsing, command enum, validation helpers, and date parsing from DobbyLogic. The class now applies task operations, handles persistence, and displays command-provided messages, while Parser and command objects own input interpretation. Preserve the existing task behavior and console output.

commitResults.messageBody:
Numbered commands were selected through two boolean flags and a nested conditional, making valid flag combinations difficult to understand.

Select the command directly from its input keyword so each supported operation is explicit and future changes remain localized.

Task reconstruction combined common validation, subtype parsing, date conversion, and status restoration in one long method. Positional literals also made the save format harder to understand.

Name the save-format fields and move each parsing responsibility into a focused helper so the high-level reconstruction flow reads clearly.

Task fields were protected and the description and type could be reassigned even though subclasses do not access or modify them. This exposed more state than necessary and obscured the class invariants.

Make task state private and immutable where possible, while retaining completion status as the only mutable field.

* showTasks() now uses IntStream to number and format tasks.
* findTasks() now uses filter() and toList() to express the search directly.
* Shared numbering logic was extracted into formatNumberedTasks().

commitResults.messageTitle: GUI: Move chat layout to FXML
commitResults.messageBody: Separate the JavaFX view definitions from their controller behavior. This keeps layout changes in FXML while preserving the command handling and dialog behavior introduced by the interactive prototype.
Anchor the chat controls so they follow window resizing and enforce a usable minimum size. Add JavaFX styles for the window, controls, avatars, and distinct user and Dobby message bubbles.

Restyle the single-contact chat around the dark panels, yellow system accents, and contrasting message bubbles used by the Knock Knock interface. Use a roomy portrait window while omitting the multi-contact sidebar that Dobby does not need.
Use a close portrait of a Dobby display that better fits the compact circular avatars in the redesigned chat. Credit the image source, author, and share-alike license in the project README.

Recognize the existing exit command in the JavaFX controller and shut down the application through the JavaFX platform. Preserve the console farewell behavior while making the GUI command complete its expected workflow.
Keep Dobby's farewell visible for three seconds before closing the JavaFX application. Disable the composer during the delay so no additional commands can be submitted while shutdown is pending.

Users could not discover supported commands from within the application.

Add a read-only help command and point unknown inputs to it.

Document the command and test parsing, state preservation, and CLI output.

commitResults.messageTitle: GUI: Refine Knock Knock chat details
commitResults.messageBody:
Align outgoing messages with the window edge and add contact-oriented reply tails and header icons to better match the reference interface. Remove the stray unknown-command spacing as part of the same chat polish.

Update JavaFX for Java 25 and replace the truncated profile JPEG with a clean lossless copy to improve rendering reliability.

Numbered task responses end with a newline for console formatting. JavaFX treated that trailing blank line as text overflow and replaced the final visible task line with an ellipsis.

Strip trailing whitespace only when assigning text to a GUI dialog so every task remains visible while console output stays unchanged.

Accept optional daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly recurrence for deadlines and events, and preserve it in saved task records. Reject events whose end precedes their start so invalid schedules never enter the task list.
Save tasks under the product-specific dobby.txt name. Import the legacy duke.txt file when needed so existing users keep their tasks, and isolate both locations in persistence tests.
Expose recurrence syntax and event-order constraints in both in-app help and the User Guide. Update the console regression plan for recurrence, validation, and the new persistence filename.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add repeated mark and unmark status check
commitResults.messageBody:
* mark on a marked task reports: “Dobby sees that the task is already marked.”
* unmark on an unmarked task reports: “Dobby sees that the task is already unmarked.”
The GUI no longer displays a user profile, so the DaUser image is no longer needed. Remove the obsolete asset and its corresponding README credit.

Recurring deadlines and events are outside Dobby's intended feature set. Remove their command syntax, model and persistence fields, documentation, and tests while retaining chronological event validation.
